about:
Coffee Systems Hawaii operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, supplying breakroom essentials to businesses across Oahu. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in available sources, and no founder names appear in the provided materials.

The firm distributes a range of products organized into categories that include coffee systems, water filtration systems, coffee and other hot beverages, cold beverages, creamers and sweeteners, serveware and disposables, and sanitizer and hygienic products. It offers free local delivery on Oahu for orders exceeding $50, positioning itself as a convenient single-source provider for workplace refreshment and hygiene needs. The product lineup suggests a focus on both equipment such as brewers and dispensers and the consumables that accompany them.

Its customer base consists of businesses seeking a consolidated source for breakroom supplies, from offices to food-service operations. The company's messaging emphasizes service to the local business community, with delivery logistics tailored to the Oahu market.

The company emphasizes a local, affordable, and convenient approach, promoting itself as a one-stop shop for breakroom essentials with delivery service tailored to the Oahu market. Its stated value proposition centers on consolidating procurement of coffee, water, beverage, and hygiene products under a single vendor relationship.
